name: duospace-billing
description: Local Capacitor plugin: Google Play Billing (subscriptions) for DuoSpace's Individual Plus / Couple Plus plans. Android only — see src/web.ts for why there is no real web/iOS implementation yet. Never trusts its own reported purchase result as proof of payment; the JS side must always send the returned purchaseToken to the verify-google-play-purchase Edge Function before treating a purchase as real (see src/definitions.ts header).
author: DuoSpace

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc && rollup -c rollup.config.mjs
scripts.verify:android: cd android && ./gradlew clean build test && cd ..
